name: Candidate raises current-employer counter-offer but never declines
notes: Phase 5.1: current_employer_counter_unresolved — candidate self-discloses retention attempt without resolution.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Senior backend engineer with 8 years across Flipkart and Razorpay, currently leading the payouts squad at Razorpay.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Looking for a fresh problem space — payouts has plateaued for me. Also, honestly, my current employer is likely to come back with a retention offer when I resign; my manager has already hinted at it.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: I see. What's your notice period?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days notice, buyout possible at 1 month gross. I can negotiate early release with a handover plan.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I designed and shipped the new instant payouts pipeline handling 5M transactions a day. Owned spec to launch over five months.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your founder's blog on ledger consensus lines up with my interests, and the engineering scale you're at is the next jump from where I am.
